question: Should LongCat be accepted as a bundled provider plugin in OpenClaw core, or should it ship first as an external/ClawHub provider package?
rationale: The provider SDK can express this capability, but root policy keeps optional provider integrations plugin-owned and makes bundled provider promotion a maintainer ownership and product decision.

options.title: Bundle after PR review
options.body: Accept LongCat into the core package after the linked draft PR resolves its review blocker and supplies appropriate key-gated live validation.

options.title: External provider first
options.body: Move the same provider shape into an official external or ClawHub provider package and defer core bundling until demand and ownership justify it.

options.title: Keep manual configuration
options.body: Do not add an official plugin yet and leave LongCat users on the documented custom-provider workaround.

recommendation.title: Bundle after PR review
recommendation.body: Accept LongCat into the core package after the linked draft PR resolves its review blocker and supplies appropriate key-gated live validation.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns this issue, owns the linked implementation PR, and has recent provider/auth history in the sampled paths.
